manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball's position, velocity, acceleration, and gravitational force alongside its velocity-time plot.
manifest.description: Left, a height ruler shows a tossed ball moving up and down with live velocity and acceleration arrows and a callout of quantities. Right, a velocity-time graph plots v = u - g t with a constant slope of -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
